artemnovitckii-claude-animation-skills-b.description: Makes a 3D exploded-view animation for a reel. A phone floats on a dark studio backdrop, comes apart layer by layer (glass, screen, frame, board and battery, back), and each part gets a thin leader line and a label. Use when the user runs /breakdown or asks for an exploded view, a "what's inside" teardown or a labelled 3D breakdown of a device.

artemnovitckii-claude-animation-skills-g.description: Makes a minimal line-graph animation for a reel. A smooth black line draws itself on white (or white on black) while one big number counts up with the tip, then lands on the final value. Use when the user runs /graph or asks for a growth chart, a "0 to 100K" number animation or an animated stat.

artemnovitckii-claude-animation-skills-m.description: Makes a 3D map animation for a reel. A clean white city with parks and a river, a coloured route that draws itself from start to destination while the camera follows, a red pin that drops with a bounce, an ETA card that counts down and a destination card. Use when the user runs /map-route or asks for an animated route, a "from A to B" map, a journey or a commute animation.

Makes a minimal black-and-white line-art animation for a reel. Thin outlined steps rise one by one, a white dot hops up them, and at the top an orbit draws around it and a short second line swaps in. One quiet lowercase line of text on top. Use when the user runs /minimalistic-graphics or asks for simple black and white motion graphics, a calm self-improvement visual or line art with one moving dot.

artemnovitckii-claude-animation-skills-s.description: Makes a code-animated stick-figure explainer reel (9:16, 30 to 45 s) from a question or topic. A bright cartoon world with thick outlines, stick people with big white heads and faces, constant camera motion, whip transitions, 1 to 2 word captions, a playful underscore and cartoon sound effects, all generated in code and timed to the voiceover word by word. Use when the user runs /stick-figure or asks for a stick-figure, stickman or cartoon "what if" explainer.

artemnovitckii-claude-animation-skills-z.description: Makes a 3D cartoon "what if" explainer short (9:16) in the style of Zack D. Films-type videos, entirely in code with three.js. Procedural cartoon people, props and effects, a blue studio sky, slow-motion impacts, a red force-ripple overlay, quick whip cuts and 1 to 3 word captions timed to the voiceover. Use when the user runs /zach-d-films or asks for a 3D cartoon explainer, a "could X stop Y" or "what if" short with characters and props.
